newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Two die in Icelandic ship sinking.
newsitem.headline: Two die in Icelandic ship sinking.

text.p: Two people died and 10 others were taken to hospital after an Icelandic container ship sank south of Iceland on Sunday, the country's Marine Rescue Coordination Centre (MRCC) said. Coastal radio stations reported that the Disarfell, with 12 crew, operated by the Icelandic shipping group Samskipun, broadcast a distress signal early on Sunday morning. A rescue helicopter was sent to the scene.
"When it arrived, the boat had already capsized and there were people in the ocean," Walter Ehrat, a MRCC assistant duty officer, told Reuters.

"The helicopter was able to rescue eleven out of 12. The 12th person was found by another ship," he added. Despite all crew members wearing survival suits, the 12th person and one other crew member died, he said.
The others were taken to hospital in Reykjavik and were reported in good condition.
"The weather was pretty bad, but I have no idea why she capsized," Ehrat said. The Disarfell was carrying 582 containers of mixed cargo.
